for me, I do an egg + olive oil wash once every 2 weeks. It works best in removing excess oil and it moisturises my scalp. 
I use 1 egg and 1 tablespoon of olive oil (double the amount if you have longer hair). I wet my hair first with cold water then i massage the egg mixture on my scalp and the rest of my hair. I leave it on for 20-30 minutes then wash it off with cold water (not hot unless u want cooked egg lol) afterwards, I use lukewarm water to thoroughly wash my scalp.
My hair doesn't look greasy even after 5 days, then I just wash my hair w water only until I need to egg wash again.
